sections.title: Cloth dynamics (experimental)
notes: Turn it on in Settings > Experimental; it appears in Garment options.
Paint a mask on the garment: white moves freely, black follows the body. Fill, Clear, Smooth and Top to hem fills.
Fabric presets (Cotton, Denim, Silk, Leather, Wool knit, Rubber) and sliders for stretch and bend stiffness, weight, damping, air drag, max distance, thickness and friction.
Gravity and wind with direction arrows you drag in the viewport, wind heading and turbulence.
Play previews the cloth live on the cage; Stop puts the garment back to its fitted shape.
Export option Cloth mask: the mask goes into the garment's vertex colours (grey or one channel) and the cloth settings onto the mesh (GLB extras, FBX user properties).
Saved with the garment and in .ft3d projects.

sections.title: Body zones
notes: Body zones in the Avatar panel: Head, Upper torso, Arms, Lower torso, Hips and Legs.
Slice a zone to cut it on the nearest edge loop, with an Offset slider and draggable arrows.
Hide or show each zone, with separate left and right for Arms and Legs.
Restore a zone, or Show all and Restore all at once.
Zones only hide the avatar in the viewport: fitting and measuring still use the whole body.
Saved per avatar and in .ft3d projects.
Export option: Remove hidden zones (off by default).

sections.title: Custom cages
notes: Cage from: Garment, Avatar or Custom.
Load your own cage mesh (FBX, GLB, OBJ) by drop or browse; it is rebuilt at the Cage size density.
Shows how much of the garment the cage covers.
The cage is saved with the garment and in .ft3d projects; remove it from Garment information.

sections.title: Gizmo
notes: Gizmo bar at the bottom of the viewport while fitting: Move, Rotate, Scale, Local or World space, Reset.
Hold Shift to snap; set the rotate, scale and move steps from the bar's snap settings.

sections.title: Interface
notes: Layer transition: Paint transition button restyled as a tool.

sections.title: Experimental
notes: Liquid cage (turn it on in Settings > Experimental): a new button under Lattice deform.
Pinch the fabric and drag it along the body or lift it off; when you let go it settles back onto the skin where you left it, like pulling up a pair of tights.
Pinch size, Reach, Stretch and Grip sliders, mirror, undo.
Intensity blends the whole effect from 0 to 100%.
Skin smoothing stops the settled fabric from following every muscle: it bridges the hollows so the fit feels less tight.
Relax brush and Relax all bring stretched cage cells back toward their original size.
Reset removes the effect. It is its own layer on the garment, separate from sculpting, saved with the garment and in .ft3d projects.

sections.title: Lattice deform for garments
notes: Lattice deform in Garment options, under Sculpt garment.
Stack of up to 2 lattices.
Pre fitting or Post fitting per lattice.
Resolution: 2×2, 3×3 or Custom up to 8×8×8.
Mirror selection, Shift + click multi-select, Ctrl A select all.
Fluid move with Falloff.
Move, rotate and scale the selected points with the gizmo.

sections.title: Export
notes: Export settings overhaul.
Export to FBX support (binary 7.4).
Export GLB improvement: welded faces, correct UVs, optional UV flip.
Optional cage export.
Animation clips in rigged GLB.

sections.title: Interface usability improvement
notes: UI consistency overhaul.
Tooltips with shortcuts.
Panels remember their open state.
File > Import and File > Export submenus.
Programmable shortcuts for every action.
Wardrobe: Convert to, Duplicate, Export original / morphed.
Rename from Garment options.

sections.title: Map binding
notes: Debug poses.
Bone view and joint labels.
Experimental: Build rig uses the joint mapping.

sections.title: Gizmo
notes: Scale ring for uniform scale.
Scale snap: 0.1 and 0.5.

sections.title: Fixes
notes: Pose sliders and poses on custom avatars: correct side for mapped arms and legs, and mapped joints without skin weights.

sections.title: Cages
notes: New cage builder: even remeshing, borders kept on hems, cuffs and necklines.
Part roles: Shell, Overlay (pockets, patches) and Rigid (buttons, rivets), editable under Parts.
Thick garments get a single cage on the outer side, with an Outer side only switch per part.
Cage preview draws through the avatar while fitting.
Pieces split along a seam are stitched into one cage.
Smoother deformation, no jumps between cage triangles.

sections.title: Animation
notes: New Idle animation for the default skeleton and Build rig avatars.

sections.title: Experimental
notes: Build rig for unrigged avatars: auto-placed joints, mirrored editing, skin weights copied from the default avatar.

sections.title: Interface
notes: First-launch tutorial, restart from Info > Restart tutorial.
Settings > Delete browser data, with a refresh prompt.

sections.title: Accessories
notes: New accessory type for bags, belts, straps, holsters and helmets.
Import as accessory from Adjust fit and pose.
Paint deform mask: painted parts bend, the rest stays rigid.
Lattice deform with a box of control points.
Sculpt accessory with the garment brushes.
Parent to joint for props that never deform.
Extended influence for garments layered on top.
Low-poly cage keeps editing fast on heavy meshes.

sections.title: Cages
notes: Cage from Avatar: one smooth cage from the covered skin, ideal for belts and straps.
Accessory cages down to 0.2 cm.

sections.title: Adjust fit and pose
notes: Move, rotate and scale gizmo, rotation snap and Reset position.
Snap two points: object to avatar or garment, face to face.
Feet tilt and Feet turn for shoes.
Focus mode while fitting.
See-through colour picker.

sections.title: Layers
notes: Layer numbers with a forces icon.
Layer forces: Self / Layers above balance, levels and per-layer influence.
Layer transition group: distance slider and brush.
Compact Move row with up and down arrows.

sections.title: Painting
notes: Shared layout for mask and transition painting: Black · white or Heat map, Isolate object, size and strength.
Shift + drag smooths, Shift + right drag clamps.
Fill, Clear and Smooth for the whole mask.
Return to fitting below the panel during import.

sections.title: Fixes
notes: More precise layer transition on large garments.
Heat map colours no longer washed out.
Garments no longer sink into accessory bands.
Menu bar: File, Edit, Settings and Info.
Save and open projects as .ft3d files.
Undo and redo for wearing, layer order, visibility and sculpt strokes.
Edit > Select last.
Smooth and Construct keep cage cells even.
Layer transition: lift fades out past the edge of the layer below.
Settings: autosave interval, antialiasing, frame cap.
Custom keyboard shortcuts with JSON import and export.
Loading intro.
About closes when clicking outside.
First beta: garment import, Adjust fit and pose, proxy cage, sculpting, layers, measurements, Map binding, avatar textures and .glb export.
